Long ago, in a forest school, Guru *Drona* taught the young princes.
One morning, he set them a *test*.
High on a tree, he placed a small *wooden bird*.
“But first, tell me… *what do you see?*”
The eldest prince raised his bow.
“I see the *tree*, the *branches*, the *leaves*… and my brothers.”
The next saw the *sky*, the *bird*, and his teacher.
One by one, they *all* stepped aside.
Arjuna became the *greatest archer* of his age.
The world will always show you *a hundred things*.
